# Upstream source

This directory contains complete source snapshots of the projects listed in [../../UPSTREAMS.md](../../UPSTREAMS.md). The snapshots are preserved as independent projects, pinned by commit, and retain their own licenses, notices, and build files. Do not assume the root Wyre MIT license applies to these folders.

Wyre does not compile these projects into its Electron installers. Each project has its own runtime, build system, and license obligations; see the integration status and pinned revisions in `UPSTREAMS.md` before building or redistributing one.
